Definition: Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: David sent and enquired after Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite. The Lord's charge against David was that he turned not aside from anything He commanded, save only in the matter of Uriah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Uriah stands as the measure of David's fall: a faithful Hittite who would not go home to his wife while the ark was in the field, wronged by the king he served, and God never lets the story forget his name.
